description.value: Campbell's Gold is a family-owned honey farm and apiary in southwest Abbotsford producing specialty honeys and honey wines (mead) from their own hives. Visitors can sample and purchase mead, local and specialty honeys, beeswax candles, and beekeeping supplies directly from the farm. The operation also runs educational farm tours and workshops, making it a distinctive rural stop in the Fraser Valley agricultural corridor.

raw_osm.description: Selling mead & honey wine, specialty honeys, beeswax candles, health & home products, beekeeping supplies
